title: Major Motion (1988, Microdeal), supplied OFS ADF

build.scope: Fresh native compilation of retained Overdrive-corrected composition with rebuilt qualified DOS component and updated NativeDiskBoot.cs. The other four root sources, other ten component DLLs, compiler/SDK, compilation options and FF8000 graphics composer remain frozen. Includes relative-path/CWD, sequential metadata reads, HUNK Chip/Fast allocation flags and native boot VBlank enable. PAL OCS68000,512KiBChip+512KiBA501, one drive; bounded standalone guest ROM qualification.
build.sourceLineage: Overdrive 84525a2 (Chip priority -10, A501 priority 0), Alien Breed a897cc3 / db8b8a1; includes F17, Lemmings and caller-owned trap-zero compatibility, graphics installer FF8000.; 297c3c7e66c239ee10cb1c42da5eea67f355e8db DOS, memory-class and boot-interrupt compatibility corrections.
build.manifestProvenanceNote: The final manifest is generated directly from qualified-build-inputs.json with its accurate frozen-composition scope, actual qualified production commit, five root-source hashes and eleven actual component hashes. The separate baseline and intermediate manifests retain their own original identities.

interruptedBuild.note: VBlank-only candidate compile deliberately interrupted after discovering ignored HUNK memory flags. No qualified ROM was produced or used from this attempt.

crossRomScreenshotComparison.method: Full-viewport RGB comparison after decoding 32-bit BI_RGB BMP. Retain raw file hashes separately; the fourth stored byte is unused BGRX, not visible alpha. This decoding does not weaken complete raw-file equality for either CPU-mode pair.
crossRomScreenshotComparison.note: Only shared absolute capture fields are compared here. Native inputs begin at4900/6000; CopperStart uses the same events shifted by8100 fields in a separate conservative schedule. This comparison is descriptive, not gameplay phase alignment.

sourceFix.qualified: Select relative-path handler from the current-directory lock, use the default filesystem only without a directory, replace the internal CurrentDir(NULL) exchange with a non-mutating read, and retain each validated metadata table during a sequential read. Honor HUNK Chip/Fast memory requirements, and hand off native boot with VBlank running under Exec.
sourceFix.main: Basic selection/read repairs already exist in main. Its narrow additional fix returns zero base lock for leading-colon paths while retaining the current filesystem port. It also contains the shared sequential metadata-read correction. Includes the same HUNK memory-class and boot VBlank fixes.

replayReceiptMode: --firmware native only suppresses interpretation of CopperStart-private receipts after takeover. Each actual --rom path/hash selects the guest firmware; execution always uses the unchanged frozen engine and CPU.
limits: Recorded opening play only; no full-game completion, later stages, all weapons, two-player mode or saves qualification.
Original-media replays and generated native probes are separate coverage. Native Kickstart1.3 OFS oracle covers two RAM layouts; its FFS trial was unavailable boot coverage, not a successful oracle.
No physical hardware timing, throughput acceptance or audio fidelity qualification.
Five retained root sources with NativeDiskBoot changed for VBlank, and a frozen component composition with one rebuilt DOS DLL; no complete moving-main/MorphOS or standard-application admission.
CPU-mode pairs require full capture/fingerprint equality for their own ROM. Cross-ROM CPU/RAM/screenshot equality is not an acceptance gate.

failureDiagnosis.note: The directory-only intermediate image passed seven existing guest probes and four new relative-DOS cases, but its original-media loader remained busy in repeated track reads. It is not final gameplay qualification. The filesystem change retains validated metadata for a Read; no device or chipset behavior is changed.

directoryAndReadOnlyImage.note: The directory and metadata-read image loads the game but stalls at its level-3 handoff with VBlank disabled. A diagnostic one-time enable reaches its own frame loop, then exposes its Chip-marked hunks residing in A501 RAM. This is not gameplay qualification and the intervention is not used by any final replay.
